export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/mina-herbs) shows 90 records, but every visible row is an IMPORT into India with MINA HERBS as buyer/consignee, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-19 MINA HERBS SHEBEKINSKAYA INDUSTRIALNAYA CHESTNUT EXTRACT- CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India Novorossiysk, RUSSIA 32019020 9812521" and "2025-12-19 MINA HERBS CREDIT AGRICOLE CARIPARMA - AGENZIA MIMOSA WATTLE EXTRACT- CHENNAI SEA, India Livorno, ITALY 32012000 8014978". Origin column = India, destination = Russia/Italy, i.e. goods arriving from Russia and Italy to Chennai; MINA HERBS appears in the 'Buyers' block ("32 CREDIT AGRICOLE CARIPARMA - AGENZIA MINA HERBS, Livorno,ITALY"), not in the 'Suppliers' block. No outbound export shipment with MINA HERBS as shipper was seen. Source counter: page header claims "Total Shipments 90 Records detected"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 (all imports).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found in the sources reachable. Searches for "MINA HERBS" Chennai GST returned no results (search backend error / no hits); volza, eximpedia and trademo free views returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply evidence: null.
note: Address on record: "NO.52/1, V. KOTTA ROAD" (Chennai area). Declared HS 320120 (wattle/mimosa extract) matches the goods actually traded in the customs rows (32012000 mimosa wattle extract, 32011000 quebracho extract, 32019020 chestnut extract) — so the HS code is factually consistent, but the direction is wrong for the claim: the visible records show MINA HERBS as an IMPORTER of tanning extracts from Russia (Shebekinskaya Industrialnaya) and Italy (via Credit Agricole Cariparma agency), not as an exporter. No export bill-of-lading with MINA HERBS as shipper was found; no traces of domestic supply found either. Role most consistent with the data: trader/importer-distributor of tanning extracts. Export status recorded as none_found on the evidence seen; domestic status unknown because GST/tender data was not publicly retrievable within the tool budget — this is a data gap, not a confirmation.
